alt: Adding values alternately to the back with append() and to the front with appendleft(), building up a deque from both ends.

steps.caption: append(1) adds 1 to the back. Deque is now [1].
appendleft(2) adds 2 to the front. Deque is now [2, 1].
append(3) adds 3 to the back. Deque is now [2, 1, 3].
appendleft(4) adds 4 to the front. Deque is now [4, 2, 1, 3].
append(5) adds 5 to the back. Deque is now [4, 2, 1, 3, 5].
append(10) adds 10 to the back. Deque is now [10].
appendleft(20) adds 20 to the front. Deque is now [20, 10].
